summary: Iteration 9 testing: Commission (Komisi) + Attendance (Kehadiran). 16/16 backend pytest cases pass; frontend E2E (admin + kasir) all green. Komisi math verified visually: rate 5% × laba_kotor Rp 161.000 = Rp 8.050 shown in UI recap row and TOTAL row. Simpan button fully visible (not clipped). RBAC confirmed: kasir blocked from /commission/settings POST (403), /commission/report (403), /attendance/settings POST (403), /komisi route redirect, no 'Komisi Online' nav for kasir; kasir sees only own attendance records (no admin recap, no start-time config). Attendance checkin/checkout flows return correct 400 messages for duplicates and out-of-order calls. Late flag honours WIB and start_time setting (round-tripped 23:59 then restored 08:00).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1217 lines - approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers (sales, ecommerce, commission, attendance, settings, auth) in a future refactor.
WIB is implemented as a fixed UTC+7 timedelta (no DST issues for Indonesia, so OK), but check_in isoformat includes the +07:00 offset - verified fmtJam parses it correctly on frontend.
attendance_checkout uses datetime.fromisoformat(doc['check_in']) which includes tz - the subtraction with wib_now() (also tz-aware) is correct; no bug.
Commission report uses regex ^{month} on created_at string - acceptable but could be more efficient with range query; functionally correct.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded online sales (Pemilik Toko has 3 Selesai orders worth omzet 230000 / laba_kotor 161000 in 2026-10).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 features (Komisi + Kehadiran) fully verified. Both the admin and kasir had attendance records today (telat since current WIB time is 23:xx). The late flag correctly triggered. Expected 400 'sudah absen masuk' behavior for repeated checkins was exercised. If retesting, note Pod time is ~23:40 WIB-ish so late=true for any 08:00 threshold.
